1.text: Nuko icyo gihe Yesu agenda anyura mu mirima y'amasaka ku isabato, abigishwa be barasonza, batangira guca amahundo barayahekenya.

2.text: Maze Abafarisayo bababonye baramubwira bati “Dore abigishwa bawe ko bakora ibizira ku isabato!”

3.text: Na we arababaza ati “Mbese ntimwasomye icyo Dawidi yakoze ubwo yasonzanaga n'abo bari bari kumwe,

4.text: ko yinjiye mu nzu y'Imana akarya imitsima yo kumurikwa, amategeko atemeye ko ayirya cyangwa abo bari bari kumwe, keretse abatambyi bonyine?

5.text: Cyangwa ntimwasomye mu mategeko, uko abatambyi bazirura isabato bari mu rusengero, nyamara ntibabeho umugayo?

6.text: Ariko ndababwira yuko uruta urusengero ari hano.

7.text: Iyaba mwari muzi uko iri jambo risobanurwa ngo ‘Nkunda imbabazi kuruta ibitambo’ ntimwagaya abatariho urubanza,

8.text: kuko Umwana w'umuntu ari Umwami w'isabato.”

10.text: asangamo umuntu unyunyutse ukuboko. Babaza Yesu bati “Mbese amategeko yemera gukiza umuntu ku isabato?” Ni ko bamubajije ngo babone uko bamurega.

11.text: Arabasubiza ati “Ni nde muri mwe waba afite intama imwe, ikagwa mu mwobo ku isabato ntayikuremo?

12.text: Mbese umuntu ntaruta intama cyane? Nuko rero amategeko ntabuzanya gukora neza ku isabato.”

13.text: Maze abwira uwo muntu ati “Rambura ukuboko kwawe.”Arakurambura, kurakira kuba nk'ukundi.

14.text: Abafarisayo barasohoka bajya inama, ngo babone uko bazamwica.

15.text: Yesu abimenye arahava, abantu benshi bajyana na we abakiza bose,

17.text: ngo ibyavuzwe n'umuhanuzi Yesaya bisohore ngo

18.text: “Dore umugaragu wanjye nkunda natoranyije,Umutima wanjye ukamwishimira.Nzamushyiramo Umwuka wanjye,Azamenyesha abanyamahanga ibyo gukiranuka.

19.text: Ntazatongana, ntazasakuza,Ndetse no mu nzira nta wuzumva ijwi rye.

20.text: Urubingo rusadutse ntazaruvuna,Kandi n'urumuri rucumba ntazaruzimya,Kugeza ubwo azaneshesha gukiranuka kwe,

22.text: Maze bamuzanira impumyi yari ikiragi itewe na dayimoni, arayikiza. Uwari ikiragi avuga ubwo kandi arahumuka.

23.text: Abantu bose baratangara baravuga bati “Mbese aho uyu si we mwene Dawidi?”

24.text: Ariko Abafarisayo babyumvise baravuga bati “Uyu nta wundi umuha kwirukana abadayimoni, keretse Belizebuli umutware w'abadayimoni.”

25.text: Amenye ibyo bibwira arababwira ati “Ubwami bwose iyo bwigabanyije ubwabwo burarimbuka, n'umudugudu wose cyangwa inzu yose, iyo byigabanyije ubwabyo ntibigumaho.

26.text: None se Satani niba yirukana Satani ko aba yigabanyije ubwe, ubwami bwe buzagumaho bute?

27.text: Nanjye niba ari Belizebuli umpa kwirukana abadayimoni, abana banyu ni nde ubaha kubirukana? Ni cyo gituma ari bo babacira urubanza.

28.text: Ariko Umwuka w'Imana niba ari we umpa kwirukana abadayimoni, noneho ubwami bw'Imana buba bubaguye gitumo.

29.text: “Umuntu yabasha ate kwinjira mu nzu y'umunyamaboko ngo amusahure ibintu, atabanje kuboha uwo munyamaboko, ko ari bwo yabona uko asahura inzu ye?

30.text: “Uwo tutabana ni umwanzi wanjye, kandi uwo tudateranyiriza hamwe arasandaza.

31.text: Ni cyo gitumye mbabwira yuko abantu bazababarirwa icyaha cyose n'igitutsi, ariko gutuka Umwuka ni icyaha kitazababarirwa.

32.text: Kandi umuntu wese usebya Umwana w'umuntu azababarirwa, ariko usebya Umwuka Wera ntazababarirwa, naho haba mu gihe cya none cyangwa mu gihe kizaza.

33.text: “Nimwite igiti cyiza n'imbuto zacyo muzite nziza, cyangwa nimwite igiti kibi n'imbuto zacyo muzite mbi, kuko igiti kimenyekanishwa n'imbuto zacyo.

34.text: Mwa bana b'incira mwe, mwabasha mute kuvuga amagambo meza muri babi? Ibyuzuye mu mutima ni byo akanwa kavuga.

35.text: Umuntu mwiza atanga ibyiza abikuye mu butunzi bwe bwiza, n'umuntu mubi atanga ibibi abikuye mu butunzi bwe bubi.

36.text: “Kandi ndababwira yuko ijambo ry'impfabusa ryose abantu bavuga, bazaribazwa ku munsi w'amateka.

37.text: Amagambo yawe ni yo azagutsindishiriza, kandi n'amagambo yawe ni yo azagutsindisha.”

38.text: Nuko bamwe mu banditsi n'Abafarisayo baramusubiza bati “Mwigisha, turashaka kureba ikimenyetso kiguturukaho.”

39.text: Na we arabasubiza ati “Abantu b'igihe kibi bishimira ubusambanyi, bashaka ikimenyetso ariko nta kimenyetso bazahabwa, keretse icy'umuhanuzi Yona.

40.text: Nk'uko Yona yamaze iminsi itatu n'amajoro atatu mu nda y'urufi, ni ko n'Umwana w'umuntu azamara iminsi itatu n'amajoro atatu ikuzimu.

41.text: Ab'i Nineve bazahagurukana n'ab'iki gihe ku munsi w'amateka, babatsindishe kuko bihannye ubwo bumvaga kwigisha kwa Yona, kandi dore uruta Yona ari hano.

42.text: Umugabekazi w'igihugu cy'i kusi azahagurukana n'ab'iki gihe ku munsi w'amateka abatsindishe, kuko yavanywe ku mpera y'isi no kumva ubwenge bwa Salomo, kandi dore uruta Salomo ari hano.

43.text: “Dayimoni iyo avuye mu muntu, anyura ahadafite amazi ashaka uburuhukiro akabubura.

44.text: Akavuga ati ‘Reka nsubire mu nzu yanjye navuyemo.’ Yagerayo agasanga irimo ubusa, ikubuwe, iteguwe.

45.text: Ni ko kugenda akazana abandi badayimoni barindwi bamurusha kuba babi, bakinjira bakabamo, ibyo hanyuma by'uwo muntu bikarusha ibya mbere kuba bibi. Ni ko bizaba ku b'iki gihe kibi.”

46.text: Akivugana n'abantu, nyina na bene se bari bahagaze hanze, bashaka kuvugana na we.

47.text: Umuntu aramubwira ati “Nyoko na bene so bahagaze hanze barashaka ko muvugana.”

48.text: Na we asubiza ubimubwiye, aramubaza ati “Mama ni nde, na bene data ni bande?”

49.text: Arambura ukuboko agutunga abigishwa be ati “Dore mama na bene data.

50.text: Umuntu wese ukora ibyo Data wo mu ijuru ashaka, ni we mwene data, ni we mushiki wanjye, ni we mama.”
